research_protocol.phase: Adaptive second selection stage; confirmation splits still untouched.
research_protocol.rationale: The first selection stage shows large gains from frequency position, but still trails raw-time CNN. Test whether a simpler readout reduces overfitting and whether local pooling still removes useful frequency resolution.
research_protocol.selection_rule: Choose the lowest five-split mean across the original three position-preserving candidates and these two; freeze before confirmation.
research_protocol.comparison: flatten_linear versus flatten isolates replacement of Dense(32)-ReLU-Dense(2) by Dense(2); fine_pooling_linear versus flatten_linear isolates local pooling width 2 versus 4.
